Chase Sapphire Preferred® Card

Earn 60,000 bonus points after you spend $4,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

Earn more on travel and dining

  • 5x total points on travel purchased through Chase Travel℠, excluding hotel purchases that qualify for the $50 Anniversary Chase Travel Hotel Credit.
  • 3x points on dining, including eligible delivery services and takeout.
  • 2x points on all other travel purchases.
  • 1x point per dollar spent on all other purchases.

Limited time offer: earn 20x total points on Lyft rides through March 2027.

Benefits

Get up to $50 in statement credits each account anniversary year for hotel stays purchased through Chase Travel℠.

Earn a 10% anniversary points boost: each account anniversary you'll get bonus points equal to 10% of your total purchases made the previous year.

You'll pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

Your Ultimate Rewards® points transfer 1:1 to leading airline and hotel loyalty programs.

Pricing & Terms

Purchase Annual Percentage Rate (APR) 19.99%–27.24% variable based on your creditworthiness and the Prime Rate. Balance transfer fee: Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater. Cash advance fee: Either $10 or 5% of the amount of each transaction, whichever is greater. The 5x total points on Chase Travel purchases are made up of 1 base point and 4 additional points. Travel is defined as airlines, hotels, motels, timeshares, car rental agencies, cruise lines, travel agencies, discount travel sites, campgrounds, passenger trains, buses, taxis, limousines, ferries, toll bridges and highways, and parking lots and garages. Dining is defined as purchases at restaurants, cafes, bars, lounges and fast food restaurants, including eligible delivery services. Points expire only if your account is closed.
